name: Kisses_1
short_caption: The robot blows a kiss by raising both hands to its mouth and then sweeping them outward.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises both hands in front of its mouth with palms facing inward, mimicking a blowing a kiss motion. It then opens both arms wide to the sides in a large outward sweep, extending its hands toward the audience. Finally, it smoothly retracts both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot's arms extend fully to both sides. Ensure there are no obstacles or people within a 1-meter radius of the robot's sides.
